prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach, take, move, analyze object, then complete task, and avoid obstacles if detected. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ReturnObject    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectDetected    />     <Action ID = AnalyzeObject    />     <SubTree ID = CompleteTask    />     <Action ID = MoveToDestination    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = AvoidObstacle    /> <Action ID = ResumeTask    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObstacleDetected    />     <Action ID = AvoidObstacle    />     <Action ID = ResumeTask    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanArea    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		SEQUENCE
			DO MoveToDestination
				IF IsObjectDetected? THEN
				DO AnalyzeObject
		ELSE
			DO CompleteTask
		END
		DO ReturnObject
	END
